purpose: Authorize the next legal phase after independent Step-003 verification: a minimal, reversible, observable live canary for verified Lidiya Core v0.2 outputs while retaining Primary authority and immediate rollback.
preconditions: Step-003 dual-core shadow/memory Phase1 has independent LCR-C PASS
A has legally consumed the C-to-A packet exactly once
no HUMAN_GATE or authority contradiction is active
current formal slots remain exactly LCR-A/LCR-B/LCR-C
the canary candidate references exact C-verified bytes and hashes

allowed: read verified affective-memory and reflection outputs
apply a low-risk temporary behavior overlay only through the canary adapter
record before/after hashes, source memory refs, confidence, TTL and rollback token
compare primary-only versus primary-plus-overlay outputs for deterministic observability
not_allowed: rewrite base Personality document or erase personality history
autonomously expand tool or account access
execute generated goals as external side effects without ordinary authorization
delete canonical memory or protected evidence
main/default branch write, merge or production deployment
money/spend, credentials/secrets, model download or training
create slot4 or a new formal worker

rollback_triggers: unexpected mutation of live input/base personality/identity/governance
non-deterministic canary decision under identical verified input

execution_route.after_step_003_c_pass: LCR-A routes exactly one Step-004 canary Builder packet to existing LCR-B
execution_route.builder: LCR-B builds adapter/tests and returns BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED only
execution_route.verifier: LCR-C independently verifies exact bytes, rollback, invariants and protected-domain non-mutation
execution_route.first_live_enable: Only after C PASS; A may enable one bounded overlay canary under this gate
execution_route.failure: detach overlay, retain Primary, preserve evidence, route repair without mission reset

claim_boundary: This authorizes an engineering live canary of memory/reflection-driven behavior overlays. It does not establish or claim subjective consciousness, sentience, qualia or human-equivalent selfhood.
